programs.description: Gautham, a security guard, comes across his grandfather's diary that takes him on a treasure hunt. Meanwhile, Sultan, a terrorist, holds a Pakistani archaeologist hostage to find a treasure.
Geetha's murder is pinned on Ramu, the man she rejected, while the real culprits, Johnny, Rahim, Swami and Kannan, get off scot-free. However, the four spoilt brats fail to elude their karma.
Sultan, a labourer, tries to save his community from an evil bourgeoisie. He decides to take down their oppressors and help his people in leading a respectable life.
Bringing the best in television.
Balachandran comes under family pressure and marries Lekha. However, when he chooses to not have children, chaos ensues within his family.
When a gang of criminals kidnaps Johnny's son, he is left with no choice but to work with Lawrence, his estranged father, to save him.
After marriage, Sukumaran's wife Kanchana demands a glamorous lifestyle. However, Sukumaran, who finds it difficult to fulfil her wishes, takes a loan which he is later unable to repay.
When Alexander, a prominent leader, is falsely accused of murdering a CM, Danny, his nephew, navigates a web of political intrigue and danger to uncover the truth and prove Alexander's innocence.

Nettoor Stephen, T K Antony and Sethulakshmi, three communist comrades, struggle to empower the labour class people. They get imprisoned when a landlord gets killed during an uprising.
Sundaresan, a grocery store owner, marries an educated girl who gets a good job in another city soon after the wedding. Though he follows her to the new city, he plots so that she resigns.
Trouble ensues after a bear escapes from the zoo and the zookeeper must find the animal. So, he disguises himself as a bear to save his job.
When an honest doctor tries to stop a burglary, his entire family is killed. Balachandra, a fierce police officer, comes to his rescue and helps him fight for justice.
Two carefree friends, Nithin and Anand, cross paths with the same woman, setting off a chain of misunderstandings that tests their bond and changes their lives.
A man with average looks, lives an unconfident life and continuously suspects and spies on his attractive wife, until she resolves to leave him due to his nature.
Bringing the best in television.
After escaping his father's control, a man builds a new life only to be torn between loyalty and truth when his past and present dangerously collide.
Mathukutty and Kariya's families are well known rivals in a small village. Subsequently, a series of unexpected events follow when they both try to plot against each other.
A man proposes to his close friend on the night before her wedding. However, he incurs the wrath of her older brothers when he elopes with her.

Trainee detectives Unnikrishnan, Prem and Ommen try their best to outdo each other and investigate a case in order to get employed at a private detective agency.
Jayarajan, the assistant manager at a tea estate, plans to steal money from his company with the help of two subordinates. However, things do not go as planned, which leaves them in a tough spot.
Appu, a young boy, grows jealous of his elder sister's new husband, a man much older than her. He dislikes him and tries to distance himself from her.
